tools.name: gen_agent_action
tools.title: Create, update, or remove assistants and their profiles
tools.summary: Use only to manage an agent's profile, settings or appearance.

tools.name: gen_analyze
tools.title: Analyze social trends, comments, hooks, and creators
tools.summary: Use only to collect sources or analyze videos, trends and research.

tools.name: gen_ask
tools.title: Ask GEN anything, or chat about a build goal
tools.summary: Use only to run a durable or scheduled multi-step goal that is not content work (content: gen_content_action).

tools.name: gen_asset_action
tools.title: Analyze, upload, import, and delete assets
tools.summary: Use only to manage or analyze owned media assets and files.

tools.name: gen_billing_action
tools.title: Read billing and manage credit purchases
tools.summary: Use only to manage subscriptions, funding or billing settings.

tools.name: gen_characters
tools.title: Manage characters, looks, and talking characters
tools.summary: Use only to manage standalone characters from an owned image or video; a video or series's characters: gen_content_action.

tools.name: gen_content_action
tools.title: Manage content resources and content ideas
tools.summary: Use only to do any content work, the default for ideas, characters, a series arc, a storyline, a storyboard or script edit, or making a video; other tools only when the user asks for something else.

tools.name: gen_discover
tools.title: Discover
tools.summary: Use only to read records, options, job results or inspect an action.

tools.name: gen_feedback
tools.title: Send feedback about GEN
tools.summary: Use only to report a problem or send product feedback to GEN.

tools.name: gen_generate
tools.title: Create images, videos, songs, and transcripts
tools.summary: Use only to generate one standalone image, video, song or transcript (content work: gen_content_action).

tools.name: gen_generate_report_ideas
tools.title: Generate report ideas
tools.summary: Use only to prepare report ideas from supplied research data.

tools.name: gen_platform_action
tools.title: Manage workspaces, API keys, preferences, and backups
tools.summary: Use only to manage workspace members, preferences or API access.

tools.name: gen_publish_action
tools.title: Schedule, publish, or remove posts
tools.summary: Use only to connect social accounts, publish or schedule posts.

tools.name: gen_sign_in_link
tools.title: Create a GEN sign-in link
tools.summary: Use only to obtain the sign-in link for this MCP connection.

tools.name: gen_task_action
tools.title: Manage recurring jobs and monitoring tasks
tools.summary: Use only to schedule work or wait for and read accepted tasks.

tools.name: gen_upload_asset
tools.title: Upload a file into an asset library
tools.summary: Use only to upload a local file into the caller's owned assets.

tools.name: gen_vidsheet_action
tools.title: Vidsheet action
tools.summary: Use only to edit or generate editable video workspace rows.

tools.name: gen_voice_action
tools.title: Clone, design, preview, and delete voices
tools.summary: Use only to create, preview or manage voices and voice scripts.

tools.name: gen_watchlist_action
tools.title: Manage monitoring watchlists and their sources
tools.summary: Use only to manage watched sources or query their findings.
